desc: Respond to IPv6 Node Information Queries
r: ninfod - Respond to IPv6 Node Information Queries
Responds to IPv6 Node Information Queries (RFC4620) from clients. Queries can be sent by various implementations of ping command.

-d
Debug mode. Do not go background.
-h
Show help.
-v
Verbose mode.
-u user
Run as another user. user can either be username or user ID.
-p pidfile
File for process-id storage. user is required to be able to create the file.
-V
Print version and exit.
